sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report documents an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern under internal case AC-HHF-005. The activity involves customer C00348 and debit card C00348-K1, which connects to 16 other cards targeted in the same micro-skimming wave. On 2017-01-07 at 15:32, online transaction 3660245 ($4.30, product code C) occurred in billing region 325.0. On 2017-01-15 at 22:51, online transaction 3660246 ($5.08) occurred in billing region 264.0, followed by online transaction 3660247 ($2.70) on 2017-01-16 at 14:04 in billing region 264.0. On 2017-01-18 at 19:30, online transaction 3660248 ($4.94) occurred in billing region 264.0, followed by online transaction 3660249 ($2.10) on 2017-01-20 at 11:03 in billing region 264.0, and online transaction 3660250 ($4.05) on 2017-01-28 at 20:45 in billing region 264.0. The customer reported transaction 3660250 as unauthorized, revealing a low-and-slow micro-charge skimming ring of 6 small online transactions totaling $23.17. This activity deviates from the cardholder's baseline prior to opening of 149 transactions, which had a median amount of $58.98 and a maximum amount of $774.08. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card. OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Case AC-HHF-005 was opened on 2017-01-28, monitoring of connected cards was initiated, and the case was escalated to an analyst. A block of card C00348-K1 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this filing is recommended and awaits fraud-manager approval, covering total suspicious exposure of $23.17.
